entities.summary: Xiao Zixian, courtesy name Jingyang (景陽) or Jingchang (景暢), formally Viscount Jiao of Ningdu (寧都驕子), was a Chinese historian best known for producing the Book of Qi, part of the Twenty-Four Histories. He was the only author of the Twenty-Four Histories to be a member of the chronicled dynasty's ruling house.
